description: This script initializes and seeds the database with default data including categories, videos, and a demo user for a media streaming platform backend.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Represents a media category such as Action, Comedy, etc.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user in the system with email and password hash.

classes.name: Video
classes.description: Represents a video entity with metadata and file path.

methods.name: None ensure_seed()
methods.description: Creates database tables and populates initial seed data if not already present.

methods.name: None _seed(db: Session)
methods.description: Inserts default categories, videos, and a demo user into the database if it's empty.
